This is Bright Market's formal escalation on LUM-811 (VAT invoice exports show blank totals).

The totals have been blank since your 5.3.0 upgrade four weeks ago. We were told the fix
would ship in the Sep 20 release; instead your bot announced 5.3.3 fixes and the ticket was
closed while our finance sandbox still showed blank exports. Our chases on the 22nd and 23rd
went unanswered.

Please explain what happened and when this was actually fixed.

Dana Okafor, Finance Lead, Bright Market

claims.text: Root cause: the KESTREL billing-v2 refactor moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0, dropping fractional cents and blanking export totals; the change went out unreviewed.
claims.quote: Follow-up while triaging LUM-811: the KESTREL refactor (billing-v2) moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the totals on export. That change is still unreviewed.

claims.text: A fix was scheduled for the Sep 20 release, which produced 5.3.3 — but 5.3.3 did not address the actual VAT rounding defect.
claims.quote: Fix is scheduled for the Sep 20 release. Please confirm which finance sandbox the export came from.

claims.text: Priya Nair closed LUM-811 as resolved on the strength of the 5.3.3 rollout and 'verified on our side' without customer-side verification, while exports were still blank in the finance sandbox.
claims.quote: Resolved with the 5.3.3 rollout; exports verified on our side. Flagging as done.

claims.text: The same day the ticket was marked resolved, Sam Rivera re-ran the finance sandbox and found VAT exports still blank, showing the 'done' status contradicted observed behaviour.
claims.quote: Re-ran finance sandbox: VAT exports are still blank. 5.3.3 did not fix it; reopening soon.

claims.text: Ravi Menon promised Bright Market that the VAT export fix would ship in the Sep 20 release.
claims.quote: We have scheduled a fix for the Sep 20 release. Keeping LUM-811 updated.

claims.text: Ravi Menon committed in lumen-general that the export fix for the Bright Market escalation (LUM-811) would be shipped in the Sep 20 release.
claims.quote: For the Bright Market escalation (LUM-811): we will ship the export fix in the Sep 20 release.

claims.text: Priya Nair told Bright Market the fix was also being tracked in 5.3.3 and asked for receipt confirmation.
claims.quote: Also tracking in 5.3.3; the billing-v2 piece is separate. Confirm receipt.

claims.text: Ravi Menon stated on LUM-811 that the fix was scheduled for the Sep 20 release.
claims.quote: Fix is scheduled for the Sep 20 release. Please confirm which finance sandbox the export came from.

claims.text: Root cause of the blank VAT export totals is the KESTREL billing-v2 refactor, which moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0, dropping fractional cents and blanking the totals on export — a change that was still unreviewed.
claims.quote: Follow-up while triaging LUM-811: the KESTREL refactor (billing-v2) moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the totals on export. That change is still unreviewed.

claims.text: The defect first appeared with the 5.3.0 upgrade: Bright Market reported on Sep 2 2024 that VAT export totals were blank since the 5.3.0 upgrade and that Finance was blocked, and this was logged as LUM-811 where VAT-format exports were confirmed to produce empty Total columns since 5.3.0.
claims.quote: Since the 5.3.0 upgrade our VAT export totals are blank. Finance is blocked.

claims.text: The first fix attempt failed: after the 5.3.3 rollout the finance sandbox was re-run and VAT exports were still blank, and the team noted 5.3.3 did not fix it and the ticket would be reopened.
claims.quote: Re-ran finance sandbox: VAT exports are still blank. 5.3.3 did not fix it; reopening soon.

claims.text: LUM-811 was closed as resolved on the false basis that the 5.3.3 rollout had fixed the issue and exports were verified 'on our side', even though the client's finance sandbox still showed blank exports — the ticket was only reopened on Sep 26 after a re-check confirmed totals were still blank on VAT layouts.
claims.quote: Resolved with the 5.3.3 rollout; exports verified on our side. Flagging as done.

claims.text: Deploy-based reassurance was misleading: the releasebot announced that release 5.3.3 was live and included billing-v2 fixes across tenants, while the VAT export totals in the client's sandbox were still blank.
claims.quote: Release 5.3.3 is live: includes billing-v2 fixes across tenants.

claims.text: The premature resolution was reversed only on Sep 26, when Nadia Chen reopened LUM-811 after re-checking the finance sandbox and finding totals still blank.
claims.quote: Reopened after re-checking the finance sandbox: totals still blank on VAT layouts.

claims.text: Ownership of the root cause settled on Sep 26 when Nadia Chen identified the 5.3.0 VAT rounding change as the true root and committed to a proper fix in 5.3.4.
claims.quote: Correct root found: the VAT rounding change in 5.3.0. Fixed properly in 5.3.4 tomorrow.

claims.text: Nadia Chen recorded the VAT rounding path corrected in 5.3.4 with exports verified with finance, closing LUM-811.
claims.quote: Fixed in 5.3.4. VAT rounding path corrected; exports verified with finance.

claims.text: Customer-side verification of the 5.3.4 fix arrived on Sep 28 when Dana Okafor confirmed the imports were verified.
claims.quote: Imports verified. Thank you — this took longer than it should have.

claims.text: Priya Nair declared LUM-811 resolved with the 5.3.3 rollout, claiming exports were verified.
claims.quote: Resolved with the 5.3.3 rollout; exports verified on our side. Flagging as done.

claims.text: Nadia Chen told the client contact that the VAT rounding root cause would be fixed properly in 5.3.4 the next day.
claims.quote: Correct root found: the VAT rounding change in 5.3.0. Fixed properly in 5.3.4 tomorrow.

claims.text: Sam Rivera promised to add the Vertex finance role mapping on Sep 6.
claims.quote: Adding the finance role mapping today.

claims.text: Ravi Menon promised a fix in the Sep 20 release for the blank VAT exports on LUM-811.
claims.quote: We have scheduled a fix for the Sep 20 release. Keeping LUM-811 updated.

claims.text: Nadia Chen committed to fixing the VAT rounding defect properly in 5.3.4 the next day.
claims.quote: Correct root found: the VAT rounding change in 5.3.0. Fixed properly in 5.3.4 tomorrow.

claims.text: The client's follow-up chases on Sep 22 were posted into the general Slack channel with no substantive reply in the records.
claims.quote: Second chase on the VAT invoice exports. Day six.

claims.text: By Sep 23 the client had escalated to a third chase and threatened procurement escalation for the still-unacknowledged VAT totals issue.
claims.quote: Third chase. We escalate to procurement Monday if nothing moves.

claims.quote: Reopened after re-checking the finance sandbox: totals still blank on VAT layouts.

gaps.note: The KESTREL refactor is asserted as 'still unreviewed' from a single triage note; no code-review or PR record was searched or cited to confirm review status at fix time (5.3.4). The unreviewed claim is one-source.

skepticNotes.text: Claim asserts 5.3.3 'did not address the actual VAT rounding defect' but this is inference from a post-rollout re-run; the cited Sep 20 scheduling message says nothing about whether 5.3.3 contained any VAT fix. No record shows 5.3.3's contents were inspected.

Releasebot claims 5.3.3 'includes billing-v2 fixes across tenants,' while the root-cause account says the KESTREL billing-v2 VAT change was still unreviewed and the defect was only properly fixed in 5.3.4 — the record never reconciles what billing-v2 fixes 5.3.3 actually shipped.

Claim says the premature resolution was 'reversed only on Sep 26' by Nadia Chen, but claim 3 (Sam Rivera) places a re-run finding blank exports the same day as Priya's resolution, and Sam stated 'reopening soon' earlier; the ownership of the actual reopen versus intent to reopen is inconsistent across claims 3, 10, 11, and 13.

Claim attributes both root-cause identification and the fix commitment to Nadia Chen on Sep 26, but the root cause (KESTREL billing-v2 VAT rounding, unreviewed) was already documented earlier during LUM-811 triage; Nadia's message only restates it. Attribution of 'identified' overstates the record.

Claims client chases on Sep 22 and Sep 23 went unanswered, but only Sam Rivera's Sep 21 re-run and the Sep 26 reopen appear in the extracted events. The Sep 22–26 interval is a suspicious gap with no substantive internal reply documented; it is unclear whether responses exist but were not surfaced or genuinely never occurred.
Sam Rivera promised the Vertex finance role mapping on Sep 6, but no event confirms completion. Whether this role mapping relates to the blank-VAT-export issue is left unresolved and unsearched.

Claim states customer-side verification arrived Sep 28 via Dana Okafor confirming 'imports verified,' but 'imports verified' does not clearly establish VAT export totals were verified — the wording shifts from export totals to imports, and no explicit finance-sandbox re-run by the customer is cited.

Jira issues VEG-404, VEG-407, VEG-409, KST-303, KST-305, KST-308 failed to retrieve and were never searched; any of these could contain the actual 5.3.3 contents, review status of the KESTREL change, or the 5.3.4 verification, which the draft relies on circumstantial Slack/email for.

The KESTREL refactor is asserted as 'still unreviewed' from a single triage note; no code-review or PR record was searched or cited to confirm review status at fix time (5.3.4). The unreviewed claim is one-source.
